names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 3 Αυγούστου, «Οσία Θεοκλητώ η θαυματουργή», with the rank word and the epithet left off. The page glosses the name as the one called by God, and notes that codex 73 of the monastery of the Panagia of Chalki calls her Θεόκλητη instead.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 3ης Αυγούστου — «Οσία Θεοκλητώ η θαυματουργή»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page closes with a second day, in its own words: «Σημείωση: Στον κώδικα 73 της Μονής Παναγίας της Χάλκης, καλείται Θεόκλητη και η μνήμη της αναφέρεται την 21η Αυγούστου» — in codex 73 of the monastery of the Panagia of Chalki she is called Theoklete and her memory is put on 21 August. One attestation row per church is the schema, so that second day is this note and not a second row: the row records the day page read, 3 Αυγούστου, and the 21 August reading is the page's report of a manuscript and not a second saint.gr day page. The page places her «ἐκ τοῦ θέματος τῶν Ὀπτιμάτων (Οψικίου)» and names her parents Κωνσταντίνος and Αναστασία and her husband Ζαχαρίας; no `locations` object is proposed from a theme. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The page prints no apolytikion and no kontakion, so this folder takes no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).

floruit.note: saint.gr: «Η Οσία Θεοκλητώ έζησε κατά τον 9ο αιώνα μ.Χ. στα χρόνια του βασιλιά Θεοφίλου του εικονομάχου». The page gives no year of birth and no year of death, so the century it states is recorded as a floruit and nothing is inferred from the reign it names beside it.
